messages:
Incident Bot: INCIDENT CREATED · P0 · routing -> service /v1/generate high error rate (500s) after rollout. Pager: @Devon (oncall) · Severity: customer impacting · Start: 2026-02-28T09:17:56Z

Sara P: paging Dev! alerts are spiking for gen route in us-west, multiple customers reporting failures :rotating_light:

Devon (oncall): on it, saw the PD page. grabbing logs now.

Devon (oncall): quick summary: 18% 5xx on /v1/generate from 09:10 -> 09:18. traces show handler failing at model invocation with SchemaMismatch / IncompatibleInput errors.

Mike L: looking at routing audit -> there was a channel-config change ~2h ago that pinned a variant on the gen route. pinging the author.

Josh R (infra): author is a config rollout from automation: ops-pin-job-2026-02-28. It pinned `variant: embeddings-v3` under modelGroup `r-labs-gen` for route `/v1/generate`. that seems wrong (embeddings != generative API).

Priya - Support Eng: Confirmed customer impact from AcmeAnalytics: ~120 failed requests, several data pipelines retried and now hitting quotas. Customer on slack asking for ETA.

Devon (oncall): this looks like a pin mismatch: the route expects a text-generation variant but the pinned variant is an embeddings-capable artifact. Our runtime errors when model doesn't expose the required gen inference entrypoints.

Mike L: reproduce locally with the same route config, runtime throws: `IncompatibleModelError: model capability GEN not found; variant exposes EMBEDDING_ONLY`. stack: runtime/router/variant_resolver.go:142

Devon (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) remove pinned_variant from route to allow fallback to healthy gen pool 2) if removal not fast enough, explicitly set pinned_variant to the previous stable gen variant 3) clear prefix caches to avoid stale kv binding.

Sara P: @Devon do you want me to notify CS & account manager? Acme is asking for immediate update.

Devon (oncall): yes please. Priya can send interim note: "we're aware, mitigation in progress, expect <30m".

Priya - Support Eng: sending templated note now.

Devon (oncall): executing route update, running dry-run first.

Devon (oncall): DRY RUN: `redwood routes validate --route /v1/generate --unset pinned_variant` -> plan looks good (no schema drift).

Devon (oncall): applying change now:
```
redwood routes update --route /v1/generate --unset pinned_variant --author devon
```

Ops Bot: deploy-job ops-config-updates/2026-02-28 started by devon.

Devon (oncall): update applied. verifying router pools...

Josh R (infra): router synced, backend assignments show requests routed to `gen-v2-default` pool.

Devon (oncall): watching metrics -> error rate dropping from 18% -> 2% in next 3 minutes.

Mike L: can we also lock pins so automation can't pin incompatible variants again? I'll add a blocking preflight in the pin job.

Devon (oncall): agreed. Also will run a quick cache flush to be safe:
```
redwood runtime cache flush --scope route:/v1/generate
```

Devon (oncall): cache flushed. error rate now 0.6%, tail errors look like residual requests.

Priya - Support Eng: updated Acme: mitigation applied, we see significant reduction in failures, we're monitoring and will follow up with postmortem. CSM asked for RCA.

Mike L: root cause notes so far: automation pinned `embeddings-v3` to a generative route. No validation prevented embedding-only variants from being accepted for gen routes.

Sara P: timeline for handoff? I have to step out at 09:45.

Devon (oncall): handing to Mike L at 09:45. Mike, take it for post-incident actions.

Mike L: taking over. immediate actions remaining: 1) revert automation change that allowed the pin 2) add preflight capability-check to pin workflow 3) create canary test that verifies gen route with a small sample after pin 4) notify security/compliance if needed.

Mike L: creating incident ticket and postmortem skeleton now. tagging owners.

Incident Bot: INCIDENT NOTE ADDED · mitigation: route update + cache flush · detected reduction in error rate.

Devon (oncall): forensics: check audit log entry for ops-pin-job-2026-02-28, it was triggered by a nightly pin orchestrator (cron). will isolate which commit changed logic.

Josh R (infra): found the orchestrator PR: `orchestrator: allow pin if variant.versions contains modelGroup` - missing capability validation. PR merged 02-27. rolling back that PR on the orchestrator and adding tests.

Mike L: action items (assigned):
- Mike L: add preflight capability check + block embedding-only variants on gen/chat/instruct routes (due 2026-03-07)
- Josh R (infra): rollback orchestrator permissive change and add unit+integration tests (due 2026-03-03)
- Devon (oncall): draft incident timeline and attach logs (due 2026-03-01)
- Priya - Support Eng: coordinate customer follow-up and provide compensation plan if requested (due 2026-03-02)

Priya - Support Eng: Acme asked if any data was exfiltrated or misrouted — we confirmed failures were server errors and requests retried; no evidence of returned embeddings or other user data leakage. Customer satisfied with explanation for now.

Mike L: postmortem note: add a new automated validation that 1) verifies the variant capability set includes required interface for the route (GEN vs EMBEDDING vs EMBED_GEN) 2) adds a dry-run flag in the orchestrator that simulates requests to the target variant.

Devon (oncall): closing the active page. leaving monitoring on for 2h and then we'll mark resolved if stable.

Incident Bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED · P0 -> mitigated at 2026-02-28T09:41:20Z · monitored for 2 hours.

Mike L: filling out postmortem and scheduling 1hr review with infra+runtime+devex next Tues. thanks everyone for quick coordination. :clap:
